name: Daisy Down-Set and Forbidden-Minor Equivalence
statement: Admitting a rooted down-set representation is equivalent to avoiding every pc-minimal graph in the complete daisy obstruction basis.
proof: One direction follows from pc-minor closure of daisy cubes. For the converse, a non-daisy partial cube has a pc-minimal non-daisy minor, and the complete-basis theorem places that minor in one of the two recorded obstruction families.
